title: BMI160
text: Measure linear acceleration, angular rate, and temperature from BMI160 sensor, 11 outputs, {BMM150 I2C address} sets I2C address of BMM150 sensor; {I2C module} sets the module for communication, {BMI160 I2C address} sets the i2C address of BMI160, {Enable secondary magnetometer} enables read data from BMM150 connected as a secondary sensor, {Acceleration (m/s 2 )} sets the output port for reading acceleration, {Angular rate (rad/s)} sets the output port for reading angular rate, {Magnetic Field (µT)} sets the output port for reading magnetic field, {Temperature (℃)} sets the output port for reading temperature, {Acceleration status} sets the output port for obtaining acceleration, {Angular rate status} sets the output port for obtaining angular rate, {Magnetic Field Status} sets the output port for obtaining magnetic field, {Interrupt source} sets the output port for obtaining interrupt source, {Tap source} sets the output port for obtaining tap event status, {High g source} sets the output port for obtaining high g event, {Any motion source} sets the output port for obtaining any motion event, {Data type} sets the output data type for values from BMI160 sensor, {Sample time} sets the time interval to read data, {Accelerometer range} sets the full scale for measuring linear acceleration, {Accelerometer output data rate} sets the rate at which accelerometer data is sampled, {Enable low pass filter}, {Accelerometer filter mode} selects the filter mode for low pass filter for accelerometer values, {Gyroscope range} sets the full scale for measuring angular rate, {Gyroscope output data rate} sets the rate at which gyroscope data is sampled, {Gyroscope filter mode} selects the filter mode for low pass filter for gyroscope values, {Magnetometer output data rate} sets the rate at which magnetometer data is sampled, {Single tap} enables interrupt when single tap, {Quiet Time threshold} sets the quiet time duration, {Shock Time threshold} sets the shock time duration, {Amplitude threshold}, {Interrupt generate pin} sets the pin to generate single tap, {Double tap} enables interrupt when double tap, {Duration Time threshold} sets the time threshold for second tap, {High g detection} enables interrupt when high g detection, {Time threshold(2.5 ms to 640 ms)} sets the time duration for high g detection, {Any motion} enables interrupt when any motion interrupt, {Time threshold} sets the time duration for any motion detection, {Slow motion} enables interrupt when slow motion interrupt, {Flat detection} enables interrupt when flat detection interrupt, {Theta threshold (0.7 ° to 44.8 ° )} sets the theta threshold for detecting flat detection and {Data ready} enables interrupt when data is ready. Values come from the instance.
